name: Taco Salad
description: A hearty taco salad with seasoned ground beef, mixed greens, and crunchy corn chips.
recipeIngredient: ½ to ¾ small bottle Catalina dressing

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground hamburger in a frying pan with chopped mushrooms.
Add taco seasoning mix and a little water. Continue cooking until the mixture thickens.
In a large bowl, combine the premixed salad, sliced green pepper, and red onion.
When ready to serve, add the hamburger mixture, crushed corn chips, and Catalina dressing to the salad.
Toss everything together and serve immediately.

keywords: taco salad, Mexican salad, ground beef salad
